country.name: Colombia
country.languagePolicy: Spanish is the default interface language. Colombian Sign Language and Indigenous, Raizal, Palenquero and Rrom language and cultural requirements require review with the relevant communities, territorial authorities and institutions; machine translation is not reviewed localization.

review.policy: No category becomes verified without a named qualified Colombian reviewer, current authoritative sources and review of the responsible national, territorial, community, institution or program authority.

governanceModel.summary: Colombia combines national policy and information systems led by the Ministerio de Educación Nacional with administration and DUE maintenance by certified territorial education secretariats. Higher-education legal status, mandatory program registration and voluntary high-quality accreditation are separate claims.
governanceModel.territorialAuthority: Secretarías de Educación de Entidades Territoriales Certificadas (ETC)
governanceModel.schoolRule: Preserve the DANE establishment code, site, sector, calendar, levels, department, municipality, operating status, responsible ETC, source date and review date.
governanceModel.higherEducationRule: Institutional legal personality, a program's mandatory registro calificado and voluntary time-limited high-quality accreditation are distinct and require separate current evidence.

authorities.name: Ministerio de Educación Nacional
authorities.role: national education policy, curriculum references and national education information systems

authorities.name: Secretarías de Educación de Entidades Territoriales Certificadas
authorities.role: territorial education administration and maintenance of establishment records in the DUE

authorities.name: Sistema Nacional de Información de la Educación Superior
authorities.role: public consultation of recognized institutions and programs with current registro calificado or accreditation information

authorities.name: Comisión Nacional Intersectorial de Aseguramiento de la Calidad de la Educación Superior
authorities.role: evaluation of institutional and program conditions for mandatory registration processes

authorities.name: Consejo Nacional de Acreditación
authorities.role: voluntary, temporary high-quality accreditation of institutions and programs

authorities.name: Instituto Colombiano de Bienestar Familiar
authorities.role: national child and family protection authority

curriculum.title: Lineamientos curriculares, estándares básicos de competencias and current implementation guidance
curriculum.implementationRule: Confirm education level, area, publication version, effective date, MEN guidance, territorial implementation and the institution's PEI before mapping a resource.
curriculum.supplementPolicy: External materials may supplement but never silently replace current national guidance, territorial implementation, an institution's PEI or a community-governed curriculum.

schoolDirectory.authority: MEN and certified territorial education secretariats
schoolDirectory.primarySourceName: Buscando Colegio / Directorio Único de Establecimientos Educativos (DUE)
schoolDirectory.scopeNotice: The DUE includes official and non-official preschool, basic and middle-education establishments and is maintained by certified territorial secretariats. A listing must not be treated as proof that every site, grade, service or authorization is currently active.

educationStatistics.authority: Departamento Administrativo Nacional de Estadística and Ministerio de Educación Nacional
educationStatistics.scopeNotice: Every figure must display reference year, publication or update date, measure, population, geography, sector, source and filters. Administrative records and statistical estimates must not be combined without labeling.

higherEducation.regulatoryAuthority: Ministerio de Educación Nacional through SNIES and CONACES, with CNA for high-quality accreditation
higherEducation.authorityNotice: Institutional legal personality, mandatory registro calificado for a specific program, location and modality, and voluntary time-limited high-quality accreditation of an institution or program are distinct claims. Each claim must identify its decision, scope, date and current status.

privacyAndSafeguarding.dataProtectionLaw: Ley 1581 de 2012 and current implementing rules
privacyAndSafeguarding.childrenCode: Ley 1098 de 2006, Código de la Infancia y la Adolescencia, as amended
privacyAndSafeguarding.scopeNotice: Personal-data processing, children's heightened protections, authorization, safeguarding, incident handling and institutional protocols require qualified Colombian review before real learner participation.

culturalAndLanguageRequirements.rule: Curricula and localization affecting Indigenous peoples, Black and Afro-Colombian communities, Raizal and Palenquero communities or the Rrom people require participation by the relevant communities and competent territorial authorities. BRASA must not substitute automatic translation for that process.

completionCriteria: A qualified Colombian education reviewer is named.
MEN and certified territorial secretariat responsibilities are reviewed.
Every school record preserves DANE code, site, sector, calendar, levels, territorial authority, source date and review date.
Every statistic shows reference year, publication date, definition, geography, population and provenance.
Every higher-education claim distinguishes institutional legal status, mandatory program registro calificado and voluntary time-limited high-quality accreditation.
Curriculum mappings identify level, area, version, effective date, territorial implementation and relevant PEI.
Indigenous, Afro-Colombian, Raizal, Palenquero and Rrom education and language requirements are reviewed with competent community participation.
The current consolidated data-protection and child-protection rules are reviewed by qualified Colombian counsel.
Privacy, safeguarding, accessibility, incident and consent procedures are approved by each participating institution.
No authorization, accreditation, partnership or credential claim exceeds documentary evidence.
